children: Blue Owl Capital reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $806.5M, up 10.8% year over year, and net income attributable to the company of $20M, compared with $6.3M a year earlier. Fee-Related Earnings increased 13.6% to $427.5M, while the FRE margin rose to 58.8% from 57.1%.
Revenue was $806.5M, compared with $728.0M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 10.8%.
Net income attributable to Blue Owl Capital Inc. was $20.0M, compared with $6.3M in the prior-year quarter.
Fee-Related Earnings were $427.5M, compared with $376.2M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 13.6%. FRE margin increased to 58.8% from 57.1%.
Assets under management grew 12% year over year to $329.9B. Nine-month Fee-Related Earnings increased 12% to $1.21B, with growth across all three platforms.
Blue Owl raised $48.8B over the 12 months, including record institutional fundraising in the third quarter. Private-wealth inflows had softened but recovered from May levels.
The alternative-credit interval fund reached about $3B in AUM. Management cited healthy borrowers and performance ahead of public benchmarks.

ODIT exceeded $4.5B in AUM in less than a year, while net lease and digital infrastructure pipelines remained strong. Management cited more than $140B in opportunities across those areas and $36.3B of AUM not yet fee-paying.
